Made for food services without a shop front

  • List as a Chef or Caterer — you appear under beautyflow.co.ke/chefs/ and /caterers/ for your county.
  • Use menu types for packages (e.g. “Wedding package”, “Office lunch”, “Per-plate”) and set prices per head.
  • Photo gallery for past events; tick cuisines (Swahili, Indian, vegan…) to appear on dish pages.
  • Inquiries and bookings come as WhatsApp messages with the customer's number.

Free to list

Everything above is on the Free plan. Premium (monthly) removes limits on menu items and photos.

I don't have fixed prices — can I still list? Yes. Use “from” pricing in the item name (e.g. “Wedding buffet — from KES 1,200/head”) and take details on WhatsApp.

Can I show my location? You choose: list your county and service area, or a full address.
